about_the_game:
A classic point-and-click adventure that’s pure heaven to play!

The world’s most unlikely hero is back! Angelo, the fame-hungry blogger, and his sarcastic sidekick Deemon return for another hilarious hand-drawn adventure — this time straight to Heaven.

When we last saw Angelo, his chase for likes and views had literally taken him to Hell, with the Grim Reaper as his unlikely companion. Now, after one hell of an adventure, he’s crash-landed in Heaven — where even paradise comes with paperwork.

Forget clouds and harps — this Heaven has divine bureaucracy, quirky angels, and mysteries that need solving. Alongside Deemon, Angelo will dive headfirst into celestial chaos, solving puzzles, meeting bizarre residents, and chasing his viral hit.

Can a man obsessed with fame survive eternal bliss? Or will Heaven turn out to be too hell of a quest?

Features

  • 🌟 Classic Point-and-Click Gameplay
    Explore, collect, combine, and solve your way through a story full of humor and surprises.

  • 😈 A Hilarious Duo Returns
    Angelo and Deemon’s sharp banter and ridiculous situations will keep you laughing all the way to the pearly gates.

  • ☁️ Hand-Drawn Heavenly Worlds
    Travel through beautifully illustrated environments packed with detail, wit, and charm.

  • 🧩 Clever, Funny Puzzles
    Each puzzle is crafted to make you think — and laugh — and maybe cry when you finally solve it.

  • 🎭 A Cast of Quirky Characters
    Meet angels, clouds, and celestial oddballs with unforgettable dialogue and plenty of attitude — and discover which one feels strangely familiar.

⚠️ Warning: Heaven might be just as addictive as Hell.

Add Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest to your wishlist and get ready for a heavenly follow-up that proves: classic adventures never go out of style — they just move upstairs.

short_description: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest is a classic point-and-click adventure packed with humor, puzzles, and unforgettable characters. It’s the sequel to Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest — and things are about to get heavenly chaotic.
